## About this page

This page is a companion to the [Data Maker](data-maker.qmd) page. It
loads the CSV file that page produces (`airport_route_survey.csv`) and
prints the entire dataset to the page as a Markdown table.

## Load the data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

survey = pd.read_csv("airport_route_survey.csv")
```

## Display the full dataset

```{python}
display(Markdown(survey.to_markdown(index=False)))
```
